approval_required_for: Bounded human approval is required only if current user-project identity, source-hash, Vivado-export, and tool-profile evidence leaves multiple plausible authorized compile plans or executables; no approval is requested for RTL, architecture, memory layout, pipeline timing, numeric policy, tolerance, or board-wrapper changes.

consumes: current user-supplied sample-project wrapper and simulation source hashes
immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, and numeric-policy bindings
sacg_memory_truth active contamination barriers and open retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: If the current identity, source hashes, Vivado export facts, and tool profile do not determine one source-matching authorized compile plan, record the exact unresolved fields and retain all active barriers/retry requests. Do not guess tool names, paths, wrapper names, or simulator executables; do not modify immutable sources or policies; do not run VCS functional simulation; and do not rerun or repair the connected kernel. Request bounded human approval only to choose among evidence-backed ambiguous exact-board compile authorities. If the static gate still fails deterministically, return the new report to current-layer CCTG/contract localization before any additional repair.
produces: verification/board_simulation/board_simulation_manifest.json with hash-bound identity, Vivado-export authority, ordered-command authority_refs, and authorized executables
verification/qwen_hierarchy/axi_ddr_interface.json from the targeted current gate rerun
repair/exact_board_manifest_repair_scope_record.json documenting no RTL, wrapper, semantic-testbench, checkpoint, stimulus, target-reference, or numeric-policy change
SACG repair decision update retaining current trust barriers and Stage7 retry obligations until downstream functional evidence passes
executable_actions.rationale: Repair only the failed current-layer verification capability. Reconcile the canonical board simulation manifest against the current exact identity document, the user-supplied sample-project wrapper and simulation source hashes, the cited Vivado export contexts, and the active tool profile. Populate source_identity_sha256, compile_authority, each ordered-command authority_refs entry, and only authorized command executables from those artifacts. Preserve RTL, exact-board wrapper sources, generated semantic-testbench sources, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference outputs, tensor catalog/weight-binding contract, and numeric policy unchanged. This action unlocks a future current-layer VCS boundary trace only if the static AXI/DDR interface gate passes; it does not perform that future simulation and does not reopen the connected kernel.

observations: The earliest executed current-layer failure is real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface. Its report specifically rejects simulation.source_identity_sha256, compile_authority, both ordered-command authority references, and the simulator executable authorization; this is a verification-capability and exact-board provenance failure, not RTL failure evidence.

functional_sim and every dependent board functional, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, deadlock, numeric, data-order, and semantic-evidence gate are not run because case_axi_ddr_interface failed. The missing board semantic-evidence report is therefore downstream evidence absence, not a valid reason to synthesize a golden or patch hardware.

contract_guided_debug_closure records a verification capability gap with zero localized current failure records and no lower-layer challenge. A historical board output-frontier symptom is not a current hash-bound direct-core contradiction and cannot reopen the connected kernel.

The connected-kernel replay capability is closed pass evidence: it has a hash-bound context package, fresh VCS execution, 416 accepted trace records, 1792 complete ingress and egress beats, terminal egress last, and certified elastic variable-latency boundary ordering. It must not be rerun or repaired in this turn.

sacg_memory_truth has 17 active scoped contamination barriers and six open scoped retry requests, with zero scoped open backtrack requests. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only; all barriers and retries remain active until a new current-layer verification sequence passes.
The conditional design-team review returned no_split. It supplies no substitute for the missing deterministic board identity and compile-authority evidence.
proposed_actions: Perform one bounded exact-board manifest reconciliation: bind the current identity document, immutable wrapper/testbench source hashes, cited Vivado export facts, command authority references, and tool-profile-authorized executables into the canonical board simulation manifest; then rerun only case_axi_ddr_interface.
risks: A stale or unbound identity/compile manifest could run different wrapper, simulation, Vivado-export, or simulator inputs than the user-supplied board project, invalidating any apparent AXI/DDR result.

Until a source-hash-bound board VCS run executes, model/checkpoint consumption, shape binding, numeric comparison, data order, memory image behavior, runtime behavior, AXI protocol behavior, lifecycle liveness, and implementation facts remain unproven at board scope.

Editing RTL, the board wrapper, generated semantic testbench, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model outputs, or numeric tolerance to satisfy this static gate would violate the immutable repair contract and would not establish hardware correctness.
Treating independent AXI or prefetch progress, or an old output-frontier observation, as connected-kernel failure would violate the lower-layer certificate and the elastic pipeline timing invariant.

Promotion to backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime remains blocked by the active contamination barriers and open Stage7 retry requests even if this one static gate subsequently passes.

artifacts: current user-supplied sample-project wrapper and simulation source hashes
constraints: exact user-supplied board wrapper and simulation source hashes are immutable
checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, and generated semantic-testbench hashes are immutable during repair
active SACG trust barriers and open Stage7 retry requests block promotion
edges: current exact-board identity document -> board_simulation_manifest -> case_axi_ddr_interface
current Vivado export facts and authorized tool_profile -> canonical VCS compile plan -> case_axi_ddr_interface

output.summary: Fail closed at the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system layer. The sole next causally distinct action is to repair and hash-rebind the exact-board simulation identity and canonical VCS compile-plan authority, then rerun only case_axi_ddr_interface. Do not run the blocked VCS functional simulation, infer an AXI/DDR RTL defect, modify immutable semantic artifacts, or reopen the certified connected kernel until this current-layer capability gate passes and a newly bound board trace exists.
